raw_message.reasoning:
So mapping support may fail if dicts are not dict but mapping. In merge and merge_with, they use iteritems(d). iteritems expects dict-like object with items method. For mapping, items exists. So it should work. But they also use isinstance(dicts[0], dict) check. That will fail for mapping. So we need to modify that check to accept Mapping. Similarly in merge_with. Also when iteritems(d) used, for mapping, methodcaller('items') returns items method. That works.

Thus we need to import Mapping from collections.abc. Then modify merge and merge_with to check isinstance(..., Mapping). Also maybe rename function names.
